query: SELECT latest_context_budget_json AS "latest_context_budget_json!: serde_json::Value", id, current_title, to_char(latest_context_budget_updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "updated_at!: String" FROM conversations WHERE bear_id = $1 AND latest_context_budget_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY latest_context_budget_updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
